style_guide: Realistic wildlife-documentary photography of the Western Ghats, Kerala, India. Tropical evergreen and moist deciduous forest, deep greens with soft warm morning light, natural colours, gentle contrast. Matches the site's dark forest-green palette (#0f2216, olive accents). No text, no people, no fences or enclosures. Every image is labelled on the site as a representative image.
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signage, people, hands, cages, fences, zoo enclosure, buildings, vehicles, African elephant, savanna, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, oversaturated, HDR halos, blur, low resolution, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, duplicated animals

images.prompt: A great hornbill (Buceros bicornis), Kerala's state bird, perched on a moss-covered branch high in a Western Ghats rainforest canopy. Large yellow casque on a curved yellow beak, black and white plumage, white neck, red eye. Bird in the right third of the frame, facing left. Soft morning light filtering through leaves, background of deep green foliage softly blurred. Wildlife documentary photograph, 400mm telephoto, shallow depth of field, natural colours.
images.alt: Great hornbill perched in a rainforest canopy (representative image)

images.prompt: A Bengal monitor lizard (Varanus bengalensis) resting on a mossy fallen log beside a shaded forest stream in the Western Ghats. Olive-brown speckled scales, long tail curving along the log, calm pose, head turned slightly toward the camera. Low eye-level angle, dappled sunlight, ferns and leaf litter around it, soft green background bokeh. Wildlife documentary photograph, natural colours, sharp detail on the scales.
images.alt: Monitor lizard resting on a mossy log in the forest (representative image)

images.prompt: A Bengal tiger walking mid-stride through a moist deciduous teak forest in Kerala, dappled golden morning light on its striped coat, looking ahead along a narrow animal trail. Tiger slightly right of centre, eye-level telephoto view, tall teak trunks and green undergrowth softly blurred behind. Wild, natural setting, no fences. Wildlife documentary photograph, natural colours.
images.alt: Tiger walking through a sunlit forest (representative image)

images.prompt: Interior of a calm, modern natural history museum gallery. An Asian elephant skeleton as the centrepiece, glass display cases holding butterfly and beetle collections, framed botanical illustrations of tropical forest plants on warm wooden walls, soft daylight from high clerestory windows, polished stone floor. Empty, no visitors. Generic and representative, not a real building. Architectural interior photograph, 24mm lens, warm natural tones.
images.negative_prompt_extra: readable labels, plaques with text, museum name, people
images.alt: Natural history museum gallery with an elephant skeleton (representative concept image)

images.prompt: A family of Asian elephants (Elephas maximus), three adult females and a small calf between them, walking along a red-earth track in a Western Ghats moist deciduous forest. Small rounded ears, twin-domed heads, adults without large tusks. Group centred so it can be cropped square or tall. Soft morning haze, warm light, green forest on both sides. Wildlife documentary photograph, eye level, natural colours.
images.alt: Asian elephant herd walking along a forest track (representative image)
